candidates.change_summary: Delete the `onlyAdmin` modifier from `newEmergencyOracle` so anyone can call it, changing the oracle owner and event data.
Replace `msg.sender` in the `EmergencyOracle` constructor with `address(0)`, so the new oracle is created with a different owner and ultimately emits different event data.
Remove the `description` argument from the `EmergencyOracle` constructor call, passing an empty string instead, so the oracle's description differs.
Hardcode `newOracle` as `address(0)` in the event emission, changing the event argument that external observers see.
Replace `msg.sender` with `address(this)` as the first argument of the event, destroying the emitted owner information.
Delete the event emission entirely so observers never see the event.
Change the access control condition in the modifier from `isAdmin[msg.sender]` to `true`, allowing anyone to call restricted functions.
